steps.name: an uninvited guest in the village
steps.objective: Find out what happened in front of [Glinda] in “Dorothy Village” and report the quest to [Runo] in “Dorothy Village”.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Put on an expression that says you saw something you couldn't see. Lower your hand on the sword a little.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The leader of Agashura came here... . What's going on?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I came here because I had a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jeryl… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: That Agashura I only heard about?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Shhh, Mandarava. We are the only ones who know this person is here now. So, be quiet and act like you normally do so that neither Vina nor Russo notices.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Now, here's the cotton.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Got it, Glinda. After all, there is only you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: What an interesting spirit. Anyway, it's been a while, %s. I knew you left Glaston, but I never thought I'd see you here.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: How can the witch help me? If you need anything, let me know. I can get it for you right now. Or, can you give me some good information?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Simply put. What is your purpose for coming here and what information do you want to give me?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: My friend is sick. Agashura, regular medicine doesn’t work. I think the medicine you made would be effective... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No way, Kazno…?)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If it's information, how about something like this? Things like fragments of Lux that lived in this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux… … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Okay. I'll make you some medicine.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Make it like this.
(Jeril hands Glinda a piece of paper that appears to have a medicine recipe written on it.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I just happened to have all the ingredients. However, this is an unfamiliar recipe. I have no idea what symptoms I will experience after taking this medicine.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It doesn't matter what the symptoms are. I won't blame you, so all you have to do is make it. And I will never come back again.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, stay with Jeryl for a moment. It'll be over soon.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Thank you. Witch. Please take care of me.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, you look tired. You can take a break after I leave. For now, listen to my story while the medicine is being made.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Why? no?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So what kind of story will you hear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You probably know Lux’s ultimate goal, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Taking away precognitive abilities? no. Becoming a god... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's right. I know it well. Now he is spreading his intentions by sending his clones to various places. The human disguised as Aaron is one of them.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The method is to break the shadows into pieces and send them to another world to take control. Until your will is accomplished.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If there is anyone who can compete with Lux in the demon world right now, it would probably be Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Strangely, Lux and Barbatos are not doing anything to each other at all. As if there was a tacit agreement.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Anyway, you know that Daphne is involved, right? And the Goddess of the Black Moon is watching. How fun… .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The medicine I asked Glinda for is for Kazno. I came this far because I was told I had to hold on just a little longer. I don't know how long I can survive with the medicine.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I wonder when he'll call Ouroboros and catch her, as he always loses track of Hilda.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Actually, they are all annoying things. There was no need to catch Ouroboros from the beginning... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's what happened when I got involved with the Der girl. Because of your useless stubbornness.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Don’t you think so too?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If Kazno had just followed Agashura's duties and lived, you wouldn't have become who you are now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You don't understand. Yeah, it's better that way.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I don't go to Glaston often, but when I went this time, I saw that it had changed a lot.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Maybe it's because Aaron left Glaston.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The only thing that happened was that a huge piece of shadow that ruled the demon world disappeared and light came into the empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me exactly what you mean.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It would be better for you to feel it yourself rather than for me to tell you. If you have to do that anyway... .

choices.text: 4. I will stop listening to the story. (proceed next)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter what I hear, it’s all vague. It’s not refreshing.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It must be frustrating. But what can I do? Everything in this world is yours. You can't avoid it even if you want to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what do you want to say?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now is not the time. I'll go find it separately. Kazno Neither the goddess nor the goddess can carelessly say something they don’t like.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: This also depends on your choice... . Oh, witch, are you done? It's good because it's fast.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I could only make about ten.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: This is enough. I guess I can endure it to some extent.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When you can't stand it, take it 30 minutes after a meal. Please leave the village as promised. Don't come back again.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's harsh, but I can't help it. Take care then, witch. Adventurer %s, see you later.
(Jeril jumps up from his spot and disappears beyond the lake outside the village.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Is this okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't know what Agashura said to you, but I know from the look on his face. Dorothy You have to leave town, right?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I guess the travel fatigue hasn't subsided yet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's probably your tendency to always say things are okay. okay. Then, take a good rest today and leave tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Glinda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If Aaron disappeared, where did he go? The only way to do this is to go to Glaston and check...)

steps.name: way back
steps.objective: Greet everyone in front of [Runo] in “Dorothy Village” and report the quest to [Moran] in “Glaston Central Square.”

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Can you two stay a little longer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I want to stay, but I have work to do.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then even Letty… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Bina, I’m sorry. If I want to fulfill my duty as a knight, I can't stay in Dorothy's village.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Black.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's not far from Glaston, so I'll come visit often. Can I leave some new cotton at the entrance to Oscar Drive?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Leticia, you know that I am a fish flapping at some kind of bait.
(Leticia throws a small cotton ball toward the lake. Then Mandarava flies over and catches it.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mandalaba flutters. Meow.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: You have just learned how to use the mandarava.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Thank you for your consideration during my stay.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It was something I had to do as the owner of the village, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. Glinda.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Leticia, come visit often. Oh, it's okay to come to hang out, but you can't come with someone. You know what I mean?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Glinda, you shouldn't kill people for no reason, so I'll definitely come alone.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's true, but something's a little strange... .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Boss, it doesn't seem like there is any ill will toward Leti.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hahaha, sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where was Elliot? I can't see it.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow, I haven't seen Elliot since Adventurer went to Lindos.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: There are times when I don't see it, but this time I didn't see it for a long time.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, if you see Elliot, tell him to use the item I gave him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell Elliot that when I see him. Then I guess I should leave now.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Goodbye. See you next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you everyone. good bye.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyang, goodbye.
(Vina waves Leticia and %s off until they are no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Nothing should happen... .

steps.name: As if nothing happened
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Moran] in 「Glaston Central Square」, and go to [Sylvia] in 「Glaston Central Square」.
2.  After speaking with [Silvia], report the quest to [Leticia] in the “North Street of the Square.”

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, %s. We're already in Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, hush. Try to be quiet for a moment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay, I'll be quiet.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Letty, what are you doing there?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, wow, what a surprise! Mr. Peony?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peonies? are you okay?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Hey, %s? I'm always fine. So why are you out here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uncle Moran, why are you talking as if nothing happened? Knights and soldiers... . Town, town, town.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, come here for a moment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Town. town. town. If you cover your mouth like that, you can't answer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. It seems like Moran has no idea... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uncle Moran always has that kind of expression on his face, so it's hard to figure out anything. But from what you say, it seems like you really don't know.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, don't stay here. Let's go to where Sylvia was. Roughly around this time, Sylvia is crying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uncle Moran, we were on patrol.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: … This is not your area.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Director Argent gave permission to check out the Oscar road as well. There is also a witness here. Do you know %s?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Oh, was that something like that? okay. I thought there was some kind of accident again.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hey, you know that I cause accidents every day. See you later, Uncle Moran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moran, let’s go.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You're busy. See you next time then.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s! Quick! Go see Sylvia, who is crying.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Why do people have to keep working? I wish I could work just four or three days a week.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Oh, I should rest for a bit and then go back.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow~. As expected, Sylvia. As expected, it was dinging.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You idiot. I told you it wasn't like that! Oh, Letty? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, how are you?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: When did you come? Are you okay? I was really worried after sending it off like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot of things happened, but it's okay.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Sylvia, you know. Uncle Moran and the people in the square. Is it the same as usual?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The knights and soldiers passing by the square seem to just be patrolling.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I found that strange too. No one remembers what happened then. It's as if someone just erased that memory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As if the memory was erased... .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Strangely enough, I remember. If everyone has forgotten, I guess it's right that I shouldn't remember that moment either... .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Anyway, Argent said to keep quiet about this. They say that if I say so, I will be breaking the royal order.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Other than that, is everyone okay?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes. I checked several times. Everyone is going about their daily lives as usual. I think the only people who remember that moment are you two, a few members of the Scars of the Red Moon Order, Your Majesty, my brother, and myself.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: That's right, Letty. My brother told me to tell you. When you get to Glaston, act like you normally would.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I guess we can just patrol as usual, right?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: %s had a message from His Majesty. When you come to Glaston, don't go anywhere and just rest for a few days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you just say that?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: That's all I heard. Ah, now is the time… . Ah, my senior will come out to find me!

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'll go into the office. See you later, %s. Leti, I'll call you later.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yeah, okay. Now stop messing around and go in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, see you later.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What are you going to do, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We must do as Your Majesty says. I'll be at the Rashuet Inn, so if anything happens, come there.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, I will. Let’s eat together later! I will live! Hehe, %s. Thank you for everything.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Then I will go home.  Goodbye.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Letty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess I need to see His Majesty and hear his story... When will I see him?)

steps.name: next destination
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in the “Street North of the Square” and follow [Lena] using the portal to “Glaston Administrative District 1”. When everything is over, report the quest to [Leef] in “Riftrasir.”

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, you came today too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, how was your day?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I patrolled from the square to the administrative district, but nothing happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you receive any messages while I was away?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, none.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, how long do I have to wait... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I guess the leader is very busy too. I haven't seen you in a few days either.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh, that person… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Do you know that person over there? I came here after seeing %s... .
It’s been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, who are you?
The clothes have only changed slightly, but I can't believe you recognize me. I feel a little sad.
Don't you understand this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Lena!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. Here… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Are you Leticia, a free knight under Captain Argent?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. By the way, who are you?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: My name is Lena Hiren. I'm here because I have something to say to %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hiren, Hiren?! ah! I've heard of it. They're from a famous noble family. I heard that they also run the best brewery in the empire.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thank you for knowing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, what happened... ? Oh, can Leti hear this story?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Your Majesty also knows about the knight Leticia. It's not a big problem, and it's okay to listen to it.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Your Majesty? Really?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I think that’s what Director Argent said.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, wow. I'm going to brag to my mom after work.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Let's keep quiet about the secret mission and just tell you that His Majesty knows Leticia.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Of course. Until now, I have never once told my family about my mission.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That's it. And %s… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: His Majesty is waiting. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leti, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Bye, see you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I also know that you have eliminated the danger that loomed over Glaston and resolved the case of the Ministry of Magic, which stood tall in the shadow of the Empire.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: By order of His Majesty, we were also looking into that matter. My name is Agent Silver Claw, and it looks like I've entrusted everything to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Oh, by the way, do you remember about him?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It was probably Aaron. I definitely feel like there was such a person.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The residents don't remember him, but some of the agents, including me, who are by His Majesty's side, seem to vaguely remember him.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The one who had tormented the Imperial Family and His Majesty so much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a question... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was wondering how much you know, Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I understand the flow to some extent. The extent to which witches, demons, and Aaron are involved in this... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: And that these events threaten the safety of the goddess.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: At Silver Claws, we are sorting out areas that could pose a threat to the empire. What you're trying to do may be a little different in direction.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I hope you understand on that point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But the surroundings are quiet. As if there were no people... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Some government offices are closed and access is restricted. It is not because His Majesty has returned, but because of what happened before, he is purifying the remaining power of the Demon World.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Wait here for a moment. I will bring your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(Kaina walks slowly towards %s and holds his hands tightly.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You had a hard time… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty, Lord Lena will step aside for a moment while you speak with %s.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No. You can stay here. Would Lena please be here too?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, what do you think Glaston is like now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is a city in itself where people live a peaceful daily life. Little did I know that unfortunate events were about to happen... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Glaston is a city as it should be. The reason we didn't do that is my fault and that of our predecessors who didn't realize what Aaron did.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thanks to %s, he was able to stop the evil he did to the Empire, but his traces still remain.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Aaron, who is like the demon lord's alter ego, just disappeared from Glaston... , his existence disappeared from the residents’ memories.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's as if someone erased the city's memory... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, guess who did that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The reason we are here today is to tell you that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe Yeji… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That witch had rabbit ears, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: A woman with rabbit ears was walking on a shore full of pink salt crystals. I was looking at a village near a cliff.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: If it's a place like that... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It appears to be Nidaros, a village on the Salar Coast in Alfheim and in Dorkalf.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: As expected, Lena. You know where it is just by hearing the explanation. and… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I could see Aaron inside the huge airship. It was somehow different from the airships currently operated by the Sylvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I can't say exactly where and how it's different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, was Barbatos not present in your foresight?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No. I couldn't see him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. I need to go there quickly.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Wait a minute, %s, are you trying to get there right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After I left Glaston, I learned of the witch's purpose. That I will never stop until I achieve my goal. So I'm going to check it out for myself.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Can you tell me what its purpose is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… , that is… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, could you please leave for a moment?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain Daphne’s purpose to Kaina.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see. Who would have thought that would have happened after the relationship between Aaron and the witch soured... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, If you go to Nidaros, understand the situation first before making your move. And if you need help, talk to Lena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? To Lena?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What is your current mission?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Together with other agents, I was tracking the whereabouts of Aaron and other related demons. First of all, I will focus on Glaston... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: So, would it be okay to move the action radius to Nidaros a bit?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, Lena will tell you the way to Nidaros. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: No need to burden yourself, %s. You just go do your job and I go do mine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so... . Thank you, Your Majesty. Ms. Lena.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'd like to be a little more helpful, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Your Majesty has done enough.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, may I ask you one question?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you ever met them or seen what happens afterward?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yeah, I didn't see it that far. If I had seen it, I would have told you. Ah, it's already time... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. I think I should go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, %s. Have a nice trip.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, Lena. See you next time. Your Majesty, this way.
(Argent escorts Kaina as she leaves and disappears into the administrative district.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, then shall we go too? But how do I get to Nidaros?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: There is a road in Riftrasir that leads to the northeast coast. Let's go and say hello to Leaf.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, you don't know... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: To go from Ljosalp to Dockalp, you must get permission from the village head. Conversely, the same applies when going from Docksalp to Ljosalp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I have something to relay about a mission to another agent... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you at Riftrasir. I'll go first and tell the director.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay. Then, let’s meet at Riftrasir.
(Lena runs from the administrative district toward the road where the castle can be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, it’s Nidaros… . I should prepare quickly and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope nothing bad happens there... .

steps.name: red colored coast
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Leef] in “Rifthrasir” and be sure to use the portal to enter “Salaar Coast.” 
2. After meeting [Askren] and finishing the conversation, defeat [Rabbit Dronimal] and [Sera Alba No. 1] at “Salaar Coast”. Then, report the quest to [Askren] at “Salaar Coast.”

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: In a crystal forest under the twinkling moonlight ♬ I wake up to the clear and fine dew ♬

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Elves of the morning, we all sing ♬ The light of Riftrasir approaches ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Twinkle moon... . Uh, %s? long time no see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, the song you just sang… . Is this your first time hearing this song? I think the students would sing it at a school on a hill somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that the next part is something like ‘Receive the Crystal Moon Forest Energy~’?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Huh? uh? Wow, how did you know?  I heard this is my first time hearing this song.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I don't know. I don't know either. I just guessed, but I didn't expect to be this surprised... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: This song is a children's song that has been passed down through the mouths of children in Liftrasir for a long time.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: By the way, did you come to see me? or not… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither. I will refuse.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Are you saying that you know what I'm going to say and you're rejecting everything? Be merciful too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't help it because I have a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If you change your mind at any time, let me know. The reason you came to see me today is because of one of your things to do, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Something suddenly came up and I had to go to Nidaros. I heard that you need permission from the warden to go from Ryosalp to Dockalp.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If so, I'll give you permission right away. If you go to Nidaros, please say hello to Embla, who runs the bar 'Ash Tree'.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He also said he was sorry that he couldn't be with Stellan's work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's what I'll say.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thanks to you, I can say hello. Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Come to think of it, it's been a long time since an outsider received permission from the village chief to go to another part of Alfheim.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When the relationship between Ryosalf and Docalf was not good, it was difficult to come and go, so only those who received permission could come and go.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's the same for elves, but there have been many cases where humans who didn't know the situation went there and got in trouble.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: These days, instead of getting permission from the village chief, people sign the official guestbook for convenience.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, %s. Would you like to sign the guestbook here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, this isn’t a guest book. Anyone can see that it looks like a contract related to Riftrasir, right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oops, I got caught. It's a joke, a joke. Now, here is the real guestbook.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah, it's a waste. I tried to press it properly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can hear everything, Director. Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, what? The time has already come to this. I'm busy today so I don't think I can talk more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, warden.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Good luck! Hello, hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later then. Director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, when is Lena coming? Oh, she’s coming.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Sorry for being late. You told Director Leaf, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, they said I could simply sign the guestbook. Lena, did you write a guestbook?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I wrote this after listening to the history of Alfheim with the director, enjoying Liftrasir Green Ale, and making a donation to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I think it strengthened the relationship between the Empire and Alfheim. I hope you don't think negatively.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I changed my mind.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Now, %s. Nidaros is this way. follow me

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then where should we go….)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: From here is Salar Beach. When you first come here, you will be so absorbed in this mysterious scenery that you will not even notice the passage of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… . It's so beautiful. I've been all over Preios, but this place is truly amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so beautiful to see those salt crystals sparkling here and there in the sunlight.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What you see over there looks like ore or rock, but it's all salt crystals.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's nice to see, but it would be better to hurry a little. Night comes quickly in Nidaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we should hurry.
Huh? uh! Uhhhh!
Wow, %s. long time no see!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Who are you?? I think this is my first time seeing you.
I feel sad. I can't believe I'm seeing this for the first time! Do you really not remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, I really don't remember... .
If you've ever seen me, you can't say I don't know... . There's no way you can't remember this face.
It can't be helped. I'll give you a hint. Cathedral of Dusk... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I don't know.
There, you beat up the priests who were consumed by evil power, right? I was among them. It was probably one of the priests somewhere on the second floor!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Still, I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I fought with so many people back then that I can't remember who was who.
Hahaha, it's okay. Thanks to you, I was able to come to my senses. You beat this handsome face so that there isn't even a single blemish on it. Isn’t this all the grace of the goddess?
I would like to formally greet you.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: My name is Askren, and I am a priest from the Order of Immortal Priests of the Hodmis Church. I recently became the youngest person to become a level 5 priest. haha.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I can't tell you in detail about what I do because it's confidential, but I did a pretty great job.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Maybe that's why the village elders said that he was [Nidaros' pride, level 5 priest Askren] and hung up a banner and prepared a party for him. Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You are an unusual priest... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I hear that a lot, Sir Lena Hiren.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Priest, you know my name. Well, it wouldn't be strange if the Immortal Priests knew my name... . We're not waiting for you now, are we?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, what a coincidence. chance. If you are in doubt, contact the church. I'm just a priest enjoying a vacation to celebrate my promotion.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Or, you can ask Director Leaf of Riftrasir. I went to say hello to you because you were on vacation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is strange...)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Nidaros is my hometown. It's very unfortunate that I can't come back unless I'm on vacation due to my work as a priest.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay, I'll trust you especially since you said you were a priest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Thank you. Even the goddess will be pleased.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I've gone to Nidaros via the Salar Coast before, but I get confused because the route seems different every time I go.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I was also on my way to the village at the time. Would you like to take the shortcut with me?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It’s a shortcut… , good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest Askren. Can I ask you for directions?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Of course, it's an honor.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, but there are a lot of monsters on the shortcut. We have to go while eradicating it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, please leave it to me. There shouldn't be monsters on the streets where residents walk.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, that's great! So, shall we handle it together?

steps.name: Sea village Nidaros
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Askren] at 「Salaar Coast」 and defeat the [Brave Magic Knight]. 
2. Arrive at Nidaros, talk to [Lena], and report the quest to [Embla].

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: At this point, the monsters seem to have been almost eliminated. You're even better than I expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not to that extent.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What were you expecting, priest?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Your fighting skills are amazing. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (Something doesn’t feel trustworthy….)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It seems like today's meeting was led by a goddess. When we get to town, would you mind if I buy you a glass of Ash Wave?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's not alcohol-free, right?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Visited Nidaros and didn't drink Ash Wave? That's really the same as saying that the freeling didn't eat the snack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something strange about the analogy.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Don’t worry, we also have non-alcoholic drinks. Master Embla will make it delicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the person Director Leaf asked to say hello to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest Askren, how long do we have until the village? This is too much of a shortcut... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Going southwest from here is Nidaros. There is a large hole over there, one of the most beautiful sights of the Salar Coast.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You can see the sea water flowing in and out, and the elves of Nidaros look at the water and pray for everyone's well-being.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Fishermen who go out to sea also measure the movement of waves. That's why that area is also called the 'Sea of ​​Wisdom'.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There's another story about that place, but I can't quite remember it. Listen to it from the villagers later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, priest. Uh, but what's over there... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there's something down here.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What was under this cliff? There's nothing but sand and sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of my mood... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It may have felt strange because it was my first time seeing it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing. After seeing the sea for the first time in a long time, many thoughts came to my mind.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Nidaros Village is this way. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like he was just surprised by something...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's not worry about that now. We need to get to the village quickly and find out what Daphne is up to.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thank you, priest. Thanks to you, I was relieved from worrying about accommodation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, priest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: What? A precious guest has come to our hometown, so of course we should provide this level of convenience.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I don’t know what your purpose is for coming from Nidaros, but… I hope you enjoy your work and return home well.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Askren Priest. That smile is very suspicious.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Because I usually smile a lot. haha. There is no one who doesn't fall for this smile... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lena? Wait a minute, what... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You suddenly point a gun at my head... . I was surprised.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: If you're going to do something, you better do it without it being noticed, priest. Did you think that we would just pretend not to notice that they keep looking at us?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I think there is a misunderstanding... .
(clap)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Priest Askren, it's up to you to answer.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Ha, you have an impatient personality. I shouldn’t tell you now, but I don’t want to die… . Take a look at this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an imperial authentication card and a church document, right?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There was an instruction from the church to help %s if there was anything to help. Should I say it's some kind of support?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Whose instructions are these?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: This is the Pope and Demigod Lydia. Look at this… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's the Pope's seal, and Demigod Lydia's signature... . I've seen this handwriting before. Confirmation complete.  I apologize for my misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, you may be misunderstood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How far do you plan to cooperate?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Well, I don't know. I don't know what will happen in the future, but I will do my best to help you during your stay.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I am a very helpful priest.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, I don't like that priest, should I throw him on the beach?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Hahaha, it's a joke... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'm serious.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'll go now. If anything happens, please let me know anytime.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You can easily find it near the Salar Coast, where you rested before entering the village, or on the east side of the village.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: And if you need information, go to Embla.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, priest.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thank you, Priest Askren.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: No. Haha, then I'll stop.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s What does that priest look like? Do you think you can trust it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well… . I don't know yet.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It seemed like he vaguely knew why we were here... . Well, it can't be helped. I have no choice but to investigate from now on... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we divide and move.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know how long it will take, but how about this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I will come to the clock tower at that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s look around the village and gather information… We need to find Daphne’s traces quickly.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I was in a hurry, but the fish still hasn't taken the bait. Ha, %s… I should have taken care of it before you came... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: … I'm a little regretful that I may have been too lucky.

steps.name: under the ash tree
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Embla] in 「Nidaros」, and complete all sub-quests (salt if you decide) and (one of the three).
2. Summarize the current situation in front of the clock tower and report the quest to [Embla] in “Nidaros.”

lines.text: Should I go in early today and rest? There are no customers and I'm sick of seeing Askren's face... . Ugh.
(An elf woman who was stretching outside the building makes eye contact with Adventurer who is approaching her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.
Customer, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, me?
Who else is here other than the guests?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Embla?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Feel free to call me Embla. But sir, how do you know me? I don't think I'm from here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At Riftrasir, Director Leaf asked me to say hello.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Grandma Leaf? What did you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't be with Stellan in his work.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Grandma Leaf was very busy, and I wasn't in town at the time. There's nothing I can do about it. Thank you, sir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind, may I ask what's going on?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Before answering that question, I also have a question. Who is the guest?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: If you came here at Grandma Leaf’s request, I don’t think you would be an ordinary person, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… no see.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Wow, is that you? He's such an amazing person! I also heard that you saved the world several times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not to that extent.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: A hero is so humble. But what's going on in our town? I don’t think I came just to say hello… .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Need some information?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm surprised by that much. If a great person like you came all the way to remote Nidaros, there must be some purpose, right?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Welcome to the right place. Although this place is small, it is a pub, so you can get a lot of information. There are also things my father left behind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. So can I ask you a few questions?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Since I am now the acting village chief, I cannot easily say anything to the guests. So, are you interested in getting a part-time job?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: It's not difficult. Think of it as a kind of deal. There are two things to do. It doesn't matter which one you do first. However, you must finish both. how is it?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: When that's all over, I'll tell you what I know. However, you only have three chances to ask questions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I will do it.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: If you're curious about the first thing, go to 'Carmen' who is practicing dancing and tell her my story. Then you will find out naturally.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Second, I hope you can solve Lars' concerns. He doesn't look good these days, I don't know what's the problem... . I think there's something adults can't help with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be waiting.
(Bench near the clock tower)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s rest a little before going to Embla… . Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ruins that Priest Askren was talking about were felt near the coast...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I looked closely as I passed by the coast, but I didn't see anything like that. Where on earth is it...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No way… Oh, there isn’t one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem to be in the sky like the Atlas Garden...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something painted on the glass of that clock tower.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Is it an angel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, when did you come?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Just before.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: But that glass picture. Normally, that would be a structure where angels open their arms and try to embrace a person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a little different. He looks belligerent because his fists are clenched.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, did you find out anything?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I think someone I know came to Nidaros, but I haven't found out anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, sorry. I'll go in first and take a rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lena, why are you doing this? The atmosphere is a little strange...)

steps.name: information at hand
steps.objective: Talk to [Embla] in “Nidaros” and report the quest to [Gregory] in “Salaar Coast.”

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Thank you, customer. Same with Carmen, same with Lars. Everyone's faces became brighter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck, Embla. Is there anything else you would like to ask me?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: No, that's enough. To be honest, I didn't expect you to take on all that work.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I wanted to know what kind of person the customer was, so I asked for an unreasonable request. Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Since I'm free at the moment, I'll give you a glass of Ash Wave as an apology. It's not alcohol, it's a refreshing drink. There will be no burden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it feels quite refreshing. I feel like my stomach has been hollowed out.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm glad it fits your taste. Then shall we begin? Now, ask anything you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask Embla?)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He is my father who passed away not long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn’t know… .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: What do I feel sorry for the customer? Then, shall we talk about my father?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: My father was an unusual person who looked after the village as the village chief during the day and ran a tavern in the evening.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He wanted his one daughter to take over the tavern, but I didn't like it so I left town. So, I haven't seen my father's face a few times during that time.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Every time they met, if they said something they didn't like, they would fight.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: While I was resting at Esnil, a pigeon with a letter flew by. It was a bird sent by Askren. Your father is dead, so come back to the village... .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Sir, don’t you know Askren? Askren... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know. Priest Askren showed us the way.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: No one knows what will happen tomorrow, and I never thought my father, who was healthy, would pass away in vain overnight.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm glad Askren was there to see the end... . They said he had collapsed near a cliff on the coast.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I don't know what caused you to collapse... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Cliff…? Is this the place where I felt something strange?)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He died after being ill for a few days, and my father left behind a strange note as his will. Look at this.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: [I, Stellan, provide all Ash Tree services free of charge to Askren, who is like my son.  If I can’t do it, my daughter Embla will take over… .]

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I am grateful to Askren, but he even notarized my father's will to the church and various organizations. You have to follow it.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Haha… , Should I say that he is like a father who is usually very playful? . Because you got along well with Askren.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were a cheerful person.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Thank you for saying that, sir. But, can this be called information? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth did Embla’s father see….? I’ll have to check later.)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You mean the clock tower in the center?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I saw it while passing by and the glass decoration was very pretty, and the bell ringing on the hour was also soft.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You mean, about a hundred years ago? The Sylvaria Empire made it a part of exchange.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: At that time, it was popular to build clock towers in elf villages. I think the residents of Nidaros requested it because they wanted something to be in the center of town.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was something drawn on the top glass?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That? It's an angel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Angel?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: The people in our village believe that there is an angel somewhere in the sea.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: They say that when something bad happens in the village, a mysterious song is heard from the sea. They say that just listening to it calms my mind and helps me endure even difficult things.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: When such stories are passed down, our village still prays towards the sea. Just one heart that wants to be happy.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: It doesn't matter whether there are really angels or not. There is no greater comfort than this kind of warm faith.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a really good story.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a village protected by angels… Could it be a battle angel like Michaela or Rafaella?)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: If you want to know more about angels, visit Grandpa Gregory.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I don't know if he told this story to entertain children, but he said he saw it in person a long time ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Grandpa who met an angel? Hmm, let’s check first….)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Nidaros is so remote that outsiders rarely come here.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Most of the customers who come to Ash Tree are villagers with familiar faces.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: So, people from other regions, like customers, stand out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: There is someone looking for you. Tell me about your impressions. Because there might be someone who remembers it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is a man in his mid to late 40s with a scar on his face and a stern expression. He is a nobleman of the Sylvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Well… .

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I've never seen anyone like that. Although I have seen a young nobleman with impressive sharp eyes. The guy looked very cold.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think he's the person I'm looking for.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'll tell you later if I see someone like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He is a noble young man with sharp eyes… let’s remember this.)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That's all I can say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Embla

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: What can you do with this much? Please take good care of me in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But, Embla… . You don't ask any more questions.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Customers do their jobs. We'll do our job. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Grandfather Gregory. Are you here?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Here, take it.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: The tuna is really big today. Thank you for always taking care of me.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Haha, that's all I can do for you.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Would you like to eat something?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: It's okay today. There, you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying that?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Who else besides Embla and you? I have something to tell you. Are you okay now? I saw something strange.
(Gregory approaches %s and whispers softly.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Could it be that the person you are looking for is the rabbit-eared woman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Looking at your surprise, I guess that prisoner is the person you are looking for. Then follow me.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Embla, I’m leaving. This customer suddenly has some business and needs to go.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Goodbye, grandpa. Goodbye to the guests too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Embla, see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elder, let’s go quickly.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: It's okay, you can call me Mr. Gregory. Okay, this way.

steps.name: sea of angels
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Gregory] at 「Salar Coast」, and enter the 「Sea of Wisdom」.
2. After defeating [Gabriella] in the “Sea of ​​Wisdom,” go through the reward room and understand the entire situation. Then go outside and report the quest to [Gregory] at “Salaar Coast.”

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Now, this is where the rabbit-eared woman appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sea of Wisdom... .

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Do you already know this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard it from Priest Askren.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I was going to tell you about angels when we meet, but the timing is a bit awkward.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: It was perfect to do it in front of the Sea of Wisdom, but then that woman appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did she go?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: One day I was fishing here, he saw me and said, “Young kid, you didn’t see me,” and jumped into the sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I tried to pull it out quickly, wondering if I had seen it wrong, but it went down so deep that I couldn't reach it.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: So, as soon as I got to the village, I found you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I wonder how long it has been since I last heard the word “kid.” By the way, is that woman a witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: It's not enough, but I can feel a little bit of magic. The woman seemed different from a typical wizard... .

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: One day, when I met an angel, he said he was lucky that I didn't encounter a witch or demon.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: That was already 50 years ago... , as clear as yesterday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Does that mean that if you encounter a witch or demon, it will be a big problem?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: … Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to hurry.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Wait, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to go in right now.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: That's reckless. This water hole is connected to the sea, so if you enter it carelessly, you could be swept out into the open sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should we do?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Take this with you. It was given to me by an angel when he saved me. Thanks to this, I was able to breathe in the sea while climbing... . It doesn't seem like it right now, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay if you give me something like that?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: The angel once told me to give this to someone who can help him, and now seems like that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Then, prepare well and go in.
Plop.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: That guy has an impatient personality. It's already gone down there. Then, should I just fish here and wait... .
Plop.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What, what? Who else went in?!
(Small waves arise and the sea water slowly turns black.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What is this?
(Part of a temple-like ruined building is visible through blurred vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, it looks similar to Coral City, but it is a little different. There is such a space to breathe in the sea...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this the ruins that Priest Askren spoke of?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, whoa.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I lived because of the angel's feather, but where do I go from here? I got in...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? Suddenly a large shadow appears...)
Boom!
Oh my, I managed to avoid the topic of intruders. It's a shame. I'll praise you once. But I won't do it twice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, the floor sank in. uh?
(When I come to my senses and look ahead, I see a woman with blonde hair and blue eyes standing with her fists clenched.)
Hey, what do you like?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
Glittering salt crystals, ugly bonito, broken ruins. Now, take your pick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?
It's what you want to be. If you have a hard time choosing, may I make a recommendation? I think salt crystals might suit you well. It breaks easily.
(With those words, the woman spreads her large wings from her waist and instantly flies in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Battle Angel? Ugh!
(Adventurer is thrown to the floor by a combo attack that includes a straight, uppercut, and roundhouse kick.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .
Wake up. It's not over yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Angel. Listen to me… . I am… .
It's noisy. How much did you suffer because of the bad guys who asked you to listen to them? Phew… .
Okay. Since I am an angel, I will give you a special opportunity. Do you want to take a few more hits and die, or surrender and run away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, what is wrong with angels?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this what Grandpa Gregory meant?)
Oh my, you have a stereotype about angels.  So, why don’t you live a good life in your next life? Like this... . uh?
(At that moment, someone grabs the angel's wrist.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hello, Gabriella.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Who are you? Who are you, do you know my name? Can't you let go of this hand?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: … Ugh. What are you? Hey, I'm not strong enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Why do you, Hecate's power... . No, are you a demon?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It's not a demon, and it has a bit of Hecate's power, but it's different from Hecate.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Let’s talk about this!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It's funny because the angel lied so blatantly. If you let go, he'll punch you right away.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Okay. Instead of letting go, I will take ‘Star Tears’ with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tears of stars?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: … Just take it!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe, I can't wait to see what Gabriela will do with me. I'll go first. Okay then.
(With those words, Daphne disappears before my eyes.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Haha, I'm going crazy. It was a look in his eyes that clearly knew where he was... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Gabriella, please tell me… .
(Before Adventurer can explain properly, Gabriella disappears somewhere with a powerful flap of her wings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Hello Gabriella! wait a minute!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … We couldn't talk properly and misunderstandings piled up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I can't help it. Even if I had to search all over the place, I had no choice but to meet Gabriella and talk to her properly... .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne, where are you?
Bang!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne, it comes out when you have nice things to say. are you okay. I don't mean to hurt you.
Bang!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Let’s solve it through conversation. You know Hecate too.
Bang!
(Contrary to what Gabriella says, she is kicking and smashing things in front of her with her fists.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, how do I explain it? He seems like the type of person who doesn't listen to people properly... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You don't have to be wary of me here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did it come from?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I still have a lot of doubts. Put that thought aside for a moment. Let's think about the next thing later.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There is something you need to do in this space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why should I… for you? .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The reason I came down here is to seal Aaron.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's true... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now Aaron is aiming for ‘Star Tears’. I plan to use that as bait to seal Aaron away. Of course, the odds are not high, so you'll have to leave it to luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if I fail?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There will be a price to pay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me in more detail. hurry.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Please buy me some time.
(With those words, Daphne turns her head and screams in the direction where Gabriella is.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Gabriela!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The tears of the stars you protect are here.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: That's not possible!!
(Gabriella screams and flies to where Daphne and Adventurer are.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, please take care of me. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne? Daphne! what? Uh, where did you go?!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne!!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Give me the star tears I’m holding in my hand!! hurry!!
(Gabriella extends her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, Daphne is gone now. Let me explain.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne, the warning is over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this really what you meant by asking for more time? ha… .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Battle Angel Gabriella. By the command of the Great God, I will destroy you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Phew, let’s hold on as long as we can….)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne!!
(Gabriella's powerful attacks fly toward Adventurer one after another.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems that the power has become stronger than before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ha, ha, ha. How long can I last?...)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Now give up and just accept your fate. To withstand the angel's judgment to this extent... .
(At that moment, a large flash of light flashes throughout the space and it shakes as if there is an earthquake.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: What, what?!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: … Why were you pretending to be Daphne?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Uh, this is… .
(At that moment, Gabriella hastily picks up something that fell at %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Michaela’s feather here…? .
(Gabriella holds the feather in her arms and closes her eyes, and only then does the shaking space stop.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Mika, Rafi, Ur… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. Let me formally introduce you. My name is Gav, Battle Angel Gabriella.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you ever read the memories of other angels?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I also learned about Iris, the new star god.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't even know that. Gav misunderstood and almost hurt me.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gav didn't mean that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, please feel free to speak. You're not really this kind of person.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Whoa, is that okay? It's been a while since I've said something like this since I think of my sisters, but it's so hard.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Tears of stars! This is not the time to be like this.
(With those words, someone behind Gabriella taps her shoulder with a cane.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Please be quiet for a moment.
(Gabriella, who was about to swing her fist, loses consciousness and falls to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, please be quiet so you don't wake the angel. If you make too much noise, I don't know what I'll do.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Unfortunately, Aaron could not be sealed. I was very unlucky this time. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You and I just have more work to do... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Sometime in ancient times that is not exactly known... . Some living beings wanted to meet the god who took care of them. So, I constantly created things without God knowing.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: A large ship with wings that can go to the realm of the gods has been completed.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: But there was one small problem. There was no fuel.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Then one day, the time came when the gods disappeared and fled outside the world. Beings who were once gods took away their ‘wings’ in order to survive.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The method they found to move the wings that were stopped without fuel... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Those are the tears of stars. It is a decision that contains the soul of many lives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait… . That means the gods... … .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: … Should we stop talking about old times?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron will soon take to the wings and head deep into the realm of the gods. And it will destroy everything that gets in its way.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The moment it hits that, the great wall will collapse and everything inside Etoire will fly out.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That's how the power of the demon world will come in and spread throughout the world. Isn't it a bit excessive to say that it is the struggle of someone who can't obtain the power of a witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do those wings go... … .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You know it too. It's called Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, the star's tears will need to warm up a bit before the wings can operate. Still, it's better to hurry.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If you hesitate, everyone will disappear.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Well then, good luck, %s.
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Daphne disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: … ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you out of your mind, Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'm fine. But, the tears of the stars... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and stop the wings from moving. So, Gabriela, you are resting here.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Wings of Icarus... . You know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was called Icarus... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell briefly about Aaron, including the story he heard from Daphne.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: There once was a person whose name I don't even remember. When he stopped the wings from operating and disappeared, I ran away holding it.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: As the twisted ones were chasing the Star Tear, a huge explosion occurred somewhere and I fell into the sea.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I could have disappeared from the shock, but when I opened my eyes, I was able to breathe and move without any problems.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: 'Star Tears', a soul stone created by a twisted person by collecting the souls of life, protected the angel who could not protect life.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I was able to stay in the new space 'Sea of Wisdom'... . Is this a curse or a blessing... , I couldn’t get up to the ground.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's similar to other angels.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: … So from then on, I made it my mission to protect the tears of the stars, and I promised myself that I would never give them up to the enemies.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: But I never thought I would miss it like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, don’t worry. Trust me.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: All I can do now is trust %s and wait.
(Gabriella approaches %s and gently kisses him on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Don't be surprised. This is my greeting from Gabriela. %s means trusting you... .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: If you go up you can get to the coast, but it takes a long time. Since we don't have time, I'll help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How?
(Gabriella holds Adventurer with one hand and lifts it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go, Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: It's lighter than I thought. Close your eyes and think, ‘I am a bird, I have become a bird.’

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Bird?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'm going to blow it out of the sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriela, wait a minute!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Haaaaa!!
(With a loud cheer, Gabriella throws Adventurer upward with all her might. Then, a whirlpool arises and rises together with Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: … Hurry up… , %s. It's not enough, but my wings will open the way.

steps.name: Adventurer Is rental available?
steps.objective: Talk to [Gregory] at “Salar Coast” and report the quest to [Askren] at “Salar Coast”.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: … ?! Flying fish? Nope.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaa!!
(Gregory spots Adventurer bouncing into the air with a wave and quickly jumps up to catch it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh?
Boom!
(Gregory lands on the sandy beach with a loud sound and puts down Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Phew, it's been a while since I ran. Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I lived. Thank you, Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I guess the angel threw you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: When I saw the angel, he said the same thing. At that time, there was no one to accept me, so I buried my head in the sand.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: By the way, did you do well in what you did? I haven't seen anyone else other than you come out... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, %s! You are here!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest Askren?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Grandpa Gregory, I have a situation and need to borrow %s.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: … The ruins I mentioned before are subtle, but they seem to be moving at a slow pace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ruins? no way… … .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, hurry up. Lord Lena is waiting.

steps.name: ancient wings
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Askren] at 「Salar Coast」, and enter 「Wings of Icarus」.
2. After defeating [Grendel] in “Wings of Icarus,” obtain <Withered Star Tears>. Then go through the reward room and when everything is over, go outside and report the quest to [Askren] at “Salaar Coast”.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Can you feel it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute… . Still good... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The world is still full of unbelievable things.  I can't believe something like that happened in such a short period of time... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, I have something to tell you... . no. I'll do it a little later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena. But priest, I still don’t get the feeling you mentioned.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Let me help you. Could you please give me your hand for a moment? If you use a little divine power... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Can you feel it now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what's over there?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes?
(As Askren looks forward at the words of %s, a huge shadow falls on the Salar coast.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The wings of Icarus... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, what did you just say? If it's Icarus' wings... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: A winged ship on which the Twisted One flew toward the sun in the twilight. Wings of Icarus... . Apparently, it was destroyed and crashed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: That's the church's secret record, oops... . Well, I guess I can tell %s.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: … I am?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Sir Lena, since this is something you learned during your mission, I hope you will keep it quiet.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay, priest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Anyway, %s must have known about these wings from the Sea of Wisdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest, do you know how to get to those wings? Wasn't there anything like that in the church's secret records?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There is. I happened to see something that even the Pope kept secret. It was really a coincidence.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: “When wizard Zerenis arrived at the Salar Coast, he discovered wings. The wings guided him. He saw the past and future where his wings disappeared... … .」

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I don't know exactly what you mean, but... . %s, what is that feather? It's on my clothes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, is it Gabriella? The scent is similar to Gabriella... . Uh, huh? Where are you flying to?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I will hold on to it. uh… . That… .
(Askren and %s's gaze rests on the spot where Gabriela's wing feather fell. A strangely shaped structure that was not visible until a moment ago stands right in front of the feather.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Unfair? Could it be that those wings refer to this airship?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I have never seen such a huge airship before. I never thought it would appear before my eyes like this. Ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: An invisible wall has been erected blocking access.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Is it possible that only %s can be reached? I can't either.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I can see the way up to this airship... . It looks like it's waiting for %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is he waiting for me, or….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, please take a look at the situation here. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, just in case, I will pray for you.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: My prayers are so effective that people who know me are lining up to ask me to pray for them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, the priest, even in this situation... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Priest, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The movement of the ruins is subtle, but you can feel it getting faster!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We should hurry. Lena, priest. Then I'll be back.
(Adventurer runs towards the airship 'Wings of Icarus' with a solemn determination. As soon as Adventurer gets on board, the airship evaporates without a trace, as if it had been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: … Okay, it's gone... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Just in case, I need to evacuate the people of Nidaros Village.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: No need to worry. The ‘wings’ are in a different realm. Even if something dangerous happens, it will only happen in that area.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Priest, what does that mean?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s Let’s trust ‘us’ as much as we trust you.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yeah, I'll believe it. However, if something goes wrong, both the priest and the church will have to take responsibility... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I know. But that noble young man... . Oh, should I not tell you?
(The moment Adventurer steps towards the huge airship, the scenery in sight changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This looks like some kind of warehouse... .
「Information… … I tell you. 」

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “Hello? “Greetings from Ferdia, the only crew member and helmsman.”

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “Passengers, please pay attention to the announcements to ensure a safe journey.”
Crackling.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “This ship is the ‘Wings of Icarus’, made with Asgardian technology that arrived in Etoire across time, and renewed as the ship of the Sylvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Asgard?!)

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “This ship is currently heading to its destination, Atlas Garden. 」

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “It will take approximately X hours to reach the destination. In the meantime, we ask passengers to adhere to the following rules.”

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「1. Passengers do not interfere with the operation of the Wings of Icarus.”

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「2. Passengers are not provided with any convenience within the wings of Icarus. 」

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「3. Passengers do nothing until the flight of the Wings of Icarus is completed.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's one-sided. What if not?

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “If it causes trouble, the lives of passengers cannot be guaranteed.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was my intention from the beginning.
Crackling.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “I don’t think about Ferdia. Based on the learned knowledge and situation, we judge the optimal result and act.”

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「… … Captain Aaron? What are you trying to say... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron?

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
