lines.text: There’s no need to hide it when everyone knows it anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron, where are you?

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: Do you want to meet me? Yes, if you want to meet me, come alive to where I am.

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: I'm curious. I wonder if you can come meet me before Icarus's wings reach the Atlas Garden... … … .

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: Ferdia.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「… … Yes, Master Aaron.”

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: Permitted.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「Target designation for anxiety elements has been completed. Activate intercept mode.”

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “With the master’s permission, we will intercept the target passenger, %s, Daphne.”
(With Ferdia’s words, the enemies hiding in the shadows slowly reveal themselves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Aaron. If it turns out like this, I will disturb you until the end.
(Aaron crashes and looks blankly at the destroyed remains of the ‘wing’.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Icarus' wings fall... . This can't be happening... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Moreover, I couldn't even get out of Salar Coast... . It was clearly flying towards Atlas Garden... … … .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: … … What if?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: There's no way I can't find the other side. I am Lux, the owner of Etoire... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Lux’s… … … .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I am Lux’s… … … . I am Lux’s… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I finally found it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron, what did you say? If you want to meet me, live and come to where you are.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I am Lux’s… … … … … .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: %s… , How on earth did they stop and destroy the wings? This is not a device that a single human can touch!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to know how that happened... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Who would have thought that the wings that had waited hundreds of years to operate would break in vain like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We defeated all the enemies that attacked us, including Ferdia, and the aircraft crashed. But here is the other side... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: There's no way it could be like this... . You don't have the intelligence to stop these wings!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: How dare I… … , how dare I… … … … .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You… . You ruined everything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to know about your situation... . what? You ruined it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess there is no other way.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Wow!!
(The moment Adventurer grabs the weapon, Aaron screams. At the same time, the ground splits, and a black shadow rises from the gap.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: All you have to do is make a plan again. I don't want to have anything to do with the main body anymore.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I didn't want to go this far because it was something Lux would do without any dignity...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: %s, I need to eat you... .
(The wall of shadows blocking Adventurer flows directly to Aaron and sticks to him.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: It will eat you up and eat away at the weak goddess connected to your spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That look... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The weapon Lux used to conquer the demon world... , the primordial darkness that flowed at the bottom of the abyss... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: It is ‘Grendel’ who swallows and pollutes everything!!

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: There is no more Aaron in human form. I'm not even Lux's alter ego anymore. … .
(When Grendel places his hand on his forehead, the darkness entangled throughout his body spreads as if swallowing the surroundings.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: I will deal with you only as Grendel. I will give you an abyss of darkness that you will never regret... .

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Die!!
(Once again, the sharp blade of darkness swinging around Grendel heads towards %s. However, Grendel's attacks are defeated by %s's counterattacks every time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've experienced this kind of evil darkness a lot... .

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: It's noisy! Die, %s!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Be it Grendel or anything else, the end of all this evil darkness is the same!!
(As soon as a gap appears between the blades of darkness, %s's attack pierces Grendel's center.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Wow!!
(As the roar that fills the other side of Salar Coast spreads, the shadow surrounding Grendel burns like a flame and disperses.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Wow... . Everything, once again… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just disappear like this!!

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Sigh. I won't disappear just because you tell me to disappear. The darkness of this abyss will hold you and shake you until the end!!
(%s's attack penetrates Grendel, but unlike before, it disperses and then regroups.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It won’t end like this. What should I do? Wait….)
(A rabbit's ears can be seen prickling through the cracks in Grendel's darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, this is not the time for you to intervene!

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Where is this witch!!
(Grendel's sharp blade of darkness is aimed at Daphne, but it dissipates like fog before Daphne's staff.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, your power has torn apart much of Grendel's darkness. Now, leave it to me.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You know that, right? There is no way to deal with the abyss of darkness that Grendel possesses.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There is no need to force yourself to touch the evil darkness. How about taking it out of my already stained hands?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Then I assume it was approved... .
(Daphne smiles and slowly walks forward.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron, who was always calm, showed himself like this. It couldn't have been easy.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: If you take on the power of other witches, do you think you can stop me?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I have to commend you for saying that. dip… . Ah, now you are not a person or anything.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: At this opportunity, you too… . Ugh? What, what?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron, no, Grendel.
(With Daphne's words, all of Grendel's movements stop. Even the stain of the abyss that was stuck to Grendel stops, frozen in time.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If you hadn't broken your promise, you wouldn't have done this.
(Daphne extends her staff and taps Grendel's head and shoulders. Then, the darkness that supports Grendel flows down little by little.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Ugh… . Wow!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Be distressed. Be in pain. Break down and scream like that. Until I can't stand up anymore.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This is the price I pay for messing with my beloved child. I'm sure I said it. Please don't touch me... … .

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Kaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I never thought you would use the dark remnants of the abyss that even Lux sealed away.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Rather, it went well. I will make it so that you can never wake up from the abyss again.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Well, stop… . Okay, stop! My, I… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Let's stop? Shall we stop then?
(Daphne taps Grendel's head and shoulders again with her staff. Then, the darkness flowing from Grendel falls to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Don't run away. Now it's time to finish it the way you want. This is the witch's power she so desperately wanted!
(Daphne notices something moving among the darkness flowing to the floor and strikes it with the tip of her wand, preventing it from moving.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, finish.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Come on!!
(%s's blow shatters something that Daphne was holding on to. Then, the darkness hovering around gradually disperses like fog and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Well done, %s. I'm glad I didn't steal the last one like Barbatos did.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew it all.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There are things you learn even if you don't want to know. Especially when it comes to you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I don't like bugs, so I left them for you. It's okay, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bugs? Was that a bug?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I will call the entity that has been forming Aaron all this time a bug. At some point, the alter ego created by Lux began to act with ego and became greedy.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So much so that it even goes against the will of the original body... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Anyway, the bug that grew up eating the souls of many living things is now gone.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I originally considered sealing it, but this method isn't a bad idea either. In other words, Lux was killed before he could do anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I don't know? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Oh, take this. I'm a little broken, but my angel would understand.
(Daphne holds out the lightened and cracked jewel to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something I want to ask. About Medea.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes. Please speak. It would be okay for me to talk to you about that child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth has everything you done up to this point been for?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It was all to protect the clan. As a result, protecting Mediah became a matter of protecting myself and everyone else.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So in order not to recreate the Mediah that was created... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: But, things didn't go as I wanted.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: At first, the child who was tried to awaken as a witch of Eastland, stronger than God, was chosen by God and became a superhuman.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It doesn't matter though.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: After all, all of this is for the sake of beings like that child and me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you really think it's for your child, Medea?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, it's not for you to decide. It's a problem for me and the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't understand words...)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now let me give you the real answer you want.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The night isn't over yet. Everything depends on the will of Goddess Hecate.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The goddess's wrath has begun the fate of witches for those who do not care, but the ending will be different.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Deerside… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'm going to 'kill God like Barbatos.' It may be a little different from the case where he, who was a god, killed another god and became corrupted.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: At first we just wanted to use each other for a while, but now we're in each other's plans.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If possible, I hope he actually despairs... . Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now, %s. Now I will turn to the God who influenced me as life. Don't disturb me. Even for the sake of the witches who have died... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: … Didn’t he seem more sincere than anyone else? Hehehe. I guess I need to be a little more sincere.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: One big enemy is gone, but you still have something to fight. Here's a suggestion. Take your pick.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Will you die fighting against those who want to kill God, or will you live without doing anything?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If it's the latter, I can help. If you're just an ordinary Etoile resident who doesn't remember anything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I refuse. That's not me.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Okay. Then I will wait for our next meeting. But I can't guarantee how it will end.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I can't help you anymore. Lastly, I wish you luck.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Of course, if you can survive until then... .
(The moment Daphne shows a small smile and waves her hand, she disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Wait, Daphne!! There’s something else I want to ask!! Where is Pandora… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which one is correct? Ha, I don’t know… . Let's go out first... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do I get out?
Crackling.
Crackling. Crackling.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「Route guidance error. Reset the route. “Please tell us your destination.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is the Perdia hologram… .

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “Perdia is a navigation system prepared for passengers. “Please tell us your destination and we will guide you through the fastest route.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I confirmed that it was clearly destroyed and not moving... Icarus' wings crashed and were broken like that. How can they work again?)
Crackling.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: 「If a destination is not entered, the route is automatically navigated to the safest location.」

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “The path from the back of Salar Coast to the front of Salar Coast is ten steps from your current location in the direction where you can see the sea.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ten steps?

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “Currently in automatic mode, passengers will be moved directly to the designated location.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, you just told me to walk, but you’re moving right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I suddenly feel sleepy… … … … .

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “Navigation ‘Perdia’ system terminated. The Wings of Icarus operation has ended.”

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: “It was nice to meet you again. Master… .」

steps.name: The place where the wings disappeared
steps.objective: Talk to [Askren] at “Salaar Coast” and go to [Gregory]. After all conversations are over, report the quest to [Gregory].

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s!! %s!! Come to your senses!

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Sue, she's not breathing.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hey, priest. Come to your senses!! You're breathing properly here.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, today we send our beloved %s back to the arms of the Goddess and we pray that you may find eternal rest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, light of eternal rest. Here to %s… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … ? Priest?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Aaaaa!! Yes, he survived. Ho, Holly!! God heard my prayers!!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Ha, you crazy priest!! Don’t carelessly send living people to heaven!
(clap)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, did I do that?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Hahahaha, I'm glad you came back safely. I also came to my senses again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But… , How did I get here?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Don't you remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I remember it clearly.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: What on earth happened? Is it all over now? Are you sure you've lost your mind because of this?
(Askren hands the star-shaped gem to %s.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(Askren and Lena are surprised to hear the story of what happened in the wings of Icarus.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Something like that happened to you.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Is everything related to the Empire over now? ah… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Sorry. %s. As a Silver Claw agent serving His Majesty, I couldn't help but think about that first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: With this, the Empire owes %s a big debt again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, priest. Does the priest also know about the other side?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Existence itself knows. However, I'm not sure how it appears or how to get there.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: However, I am glad that I was able to take %s to the other side of Salar Coast in my own way.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Priest, by any chance did you say ‘us’… .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The chief of the elf village provided help.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Long ago, ancient elf warriors fought against evil demons and tried to prevent harm to the residents.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: In the process, I accidentally discovered a space called the other side, and learned that fighting there would not affect the residents.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: If the demons who were once famous disappeared without a sound, it can be said that they have almost fallen behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Since then, the chiefs of each elven village have secretly passed on to their descendants how to discover the underworld.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, how did you discover this side of Salar Coast?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Let me tell you… .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Uncle Stellan was the first to sense something ominous and took action... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Through me, I was able to connect with other villages so that the ruins could be moved to the other side.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: … In the process, the man, who was just an ordinary elf, almost exhausted his magic and vitality and passed away.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I wanted to save him somehow, but there was nothing I could do about the boundary between life and death that not even God could easily cross.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I just prayed and prayed for you to sleep peacefully. He was a person who only worried about the village and his daughter... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's hard right now, but I plan to talk to Embla properly someday... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It must be difficult for you, too.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, it's okay. Except Lord Lena put a gun to my head.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: … Phew.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, what do you plan to do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to go give this back to the angel.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Are you thinking about plunging into the sea again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Since you tried it once, it should be okay, right? What about Lena?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I intend to return to Glaston and report to His Majesty. But not now.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'm planning to stay in Nidaros for a few days and monitor the situation, just in case. I have things to do... … .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'm sure His Majesty will allow you some time to enjoy a glass of Ash Wave while staying in Nidaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that was it in the end. Then I'll take you with me when I return to Glaston. I think I need to get some rest too.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: We will help you both rest ‘properly’ in Nidaros Village until you pass away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ah, the ‘properly’ part of the priest’s words really bothers me.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Then let’s change it to ‘moderately’. haha.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: … Priest, do it in moderation.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Lord Lena, speaking of which... . Would you like to hear how I can help ‘just the right amount’?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I have to run away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later in town, you two. I'm going to go see the angel.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gregory, it’s been a while. Seeing you reminds me of that time vividly. Did you defeat that demon back then?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I couldn't do it with my own skills, so I borrowed someone else's help... .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I had to blow it up properly.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: No. At that time, an angel gave me great help. By the way, how did you get up here? I heard you can't come... .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I can finally feel the outside air. Still, I can't escape this boundary.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gregory, thank you for your concern. I was able to survive thanks to the prayers of Nidaros residents. It's all thanks to Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What I meant was, is it okay for you to show up like this? .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: It's okay because it's not visible to normal people. And I will only appear like this when the people I care about come.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Ah, %s. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Are you here? Well, I guess I have something to talk about with my angel. I'll leave the room for a moment.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gregory, my name is Gabriella. Please call my name here next time.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: The memory of that time was so dream-like that I couldn't even ask him his name. Thank you, Gabriella.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Then, let’s talk.
(Gregory bows quietly to Gabriella and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, how did you get out?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Perhaps the cracks in the star's tears erased something that bound me.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: It feels a little strange, but I'm trying to think positively. I'm really happy that the radius of activity has increased for the first time in hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'd like to check how the other sisters are doing, but I'll leave that for another time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what happens to the tears of stars?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Now there are no relics in the world moved by Star Tear, but they must continue to be protected.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: This object, which contains the souls of countless lives, could be misused for other purposes.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: My mission is not over yet. Until I disappear, I will protect the tears of stars in the ‘Sea of ​​Wisdom’ just like before.
(With those words, the star tears in Gabriella's hand turn into dozens of small water droplets and evaporate.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Don't be surprised. I just went back to a safe place. If Iris asks for it, I will give it to you right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope that day comes quickly.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: What do you plan to do now, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? I plan to take a break and then go back. I have to go through Glaston to see Iris. Discussing what to do next... .

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I think the sisters met %s and immediately heard Iris's message... . You don’t have much to say yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? is it so? wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… . Iris… . Iris, are you listening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has this affected the Great Wall? It's quiet.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: You will tell me when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, I’ll be heading back now. I will come often and tell you about other angels.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Thank you. %s. I'd like to give you something to help you get to your destination comfortably... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Because I don’t want to stick my head in the sand.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Hehe, that's a shame. So, would it be okay to use an angel’s greeting instead?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's okay.
(Gabriella approaches %s and gently kisses her on the cheek. Then, she surrenders herself to the approaching waves and slowly disappears into the sea.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Seeing as the angel has left, it looks like the story is over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: There are days like this in life... . I wonder what happened, but I'll keep it quiet.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Anyway, I'm so glad nothing bad happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, do you know something?)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Oh, that's right... I was going to say this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I don't know when, but if you're frustrated because things aren't working out, come see me. It won't be a huge help, but it will help to some extent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. Mr. Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Now, let's go back. I have eyes to see... . Ah, what I said was a mistake.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Don't worry. My words were in vain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go? Mr. Gregory, I will take the fish you are holding.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Hey, can you lift this? If you do it wrong, you could get crushed to death.
Boom.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: As expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah, Mr. Gregory. Please save me. Hey, why is this so heavy?
(On the cliffs of the Salar coast, someone watching the scene is quietly fiddling with a silver coin.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The rabbit witch has tied up Lux's troublesome feet. Thanks to you, is that time getting closer?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe, now I have to pull down the precariously standing goddess... … .
